questions.prompt: How does the deck say AI-generated content posted as your own affects you in Year 2?
options: It's reputation risk as well as academic risk - placement employers, commissioners and admissions tutors are the people searching
It's not a risk at all
It's only an issue for final-year projects
questions.explanation: AI-generated content posted as your own is reputation risk as well as academic risk.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'The Biggest Year 2 Risk Is Complacency'? Select all that apply.
options: Thinking support is no longer needed
questions.explanation: All of these are mentioned in the section on The Biggest Year 2 Risk Is Complacency.

questions.prompt: What is the second step in 'How ESCG keeps you safe'?
options: Right person told same-day - staff do not investigate themselves; Safeguarding Manager informed; logged on ProMonitor
Concern is investigated by the student
The concern is posted on Pro Portal
questions.explanation: Right person told same-day - staff do not investigate themselves. Safeguarding Manager informed. All logged on ProMonitor.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Year 2 Pressures Are Different'? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: All of these are mentioned in the section on Year 2 Pressures Are Different.

questions.prompt: Why do Year 2 students tend to under-report concerns, according to the deck?
options: Because the safeguarding team is closed
Because they feel they should manage independently - the expectation that you should handle everything yourself is wrong
questions.explanation: Year 2 students are less likely to report concerns - because they feel they should manage independently. The expectation that you should handle everything yourself is wrong.

questions.prompt: Which PROUD value is the anchor for this Year 2 safeguarding session?
questions.explanation: PROUD anchor: Encourage Unity - looking out for peers, reporting concern, not coasting.

questions.prompt: Which is one of the three 'what changes in Year 2' for safeguarding?
options: Tutors are no longer point of contact
New pressures, complacency risk, peer responsibility
You have to report yourself monthly
questions.explanation: The three Year 2 changes are: new pressures, complacency risk, and peer responsibility.

questions.prompt: Which is a Year 2 vulnerability factor for Prevent?
options: Financial stress and debt - hard drives, printing and portfolio costs alongside travel to placement
questions.explanation: Financial stress and debt is a Year 2 vulnerability factor.
